english.title: Fail to comply with a notice served by a veterinary surgeon relating to a consignment of animals / animal products

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the person responsible for a consignment of

(A)_[animals, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMALS..),]_
(B)_[products specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCTS..),]_

failed to comply with a notice served by the official veterinary surgeon specifying a reasonable time at which the consignment had to be presented for inspection
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 15(2), 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the person responsible for the consignment of animals / products specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC
failed to comply with a notice served by the official veterinary surgeon specifying a reasonable time at which the consignment must be presented for inspection.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
